summary: Infinite visual collaboration whiteboard — enterprise enterprise deployments are vast, but tldraw and canvas tools are rising.
moat: Miro's moat is enterprise organizational memory: 70 million users across 99% of Fortune 100 companies have diagrams, sprint retrospectives, and architecture maps stored in Miro boards. Its marketplace of 300+ integrations embeds it into enterprise IT setups. The challenger movement uses lightweight canvas engines like tldraw and Excalidraw with AI prompt-to-diagram generation that runs locally without subscriptions.

challengers.name: tldraw, Excalidraw, and AI visual generators
challengers.evidence: Open-source canvas library tldraw went viral with make-real AI prototypes, enabling developers to build custom collaborative whiteboards with diagramming AI in minutes.
